title: Array methods
description:
Each function takes an array of products like `{ name: "Mug", price: 8, stock: 3, tags: ["kitchen"] }` and must not change it:

```javascript
function inStockNames(products) { }   // names of products with stock > 0, in their original order
function stockValue(products) { }     // the sum of price * stock over all products
function cheapestFirst(products) { }  // a NEW array sorted by price, then by name ignoring case
function allTags(products) { }        // every tag used, once each, sorted alphabetically
```
hints: `[...products].sort(...)` sorts a copy; `products.sort(...)` would reorder the caller's array.
`flatMap(p => p.tags)` gives one flat array of every tag. Keep each tag once by pushing it into a new array only when `includes` says it is not there yet, then sort that array.
